SUPREME COURT RULES, 1980
SUPREME COURT RULES, 1980
(General Holidays during the year, 2010)
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
20th January, 2010]
No. ,F.9/99-2001-2007-SCA, dated 26-12-2009.---In
pursuance of Circular No.2/6/2009-Public, dated 17th December, 2009, of the
Ministry of Interior, Government of Pakistan and in exercise of the powers
vested under Rule 5 of Order II, Supreme Court Rules, 1980, the Honorable Chief
Justice of Pakistan has been pleased to notify and publish for information of
all concerned that following general holidays shall be observed during the
calendar year, 2010 by the Supreme Court of Pakistan:--
